name: The Clockwork Orchid Garden
description: A surreal garden where clock gears and cogs bloom into delicate orchids, each petal moving with tiny synchronized ticks, surrounded by misty sunrise and dewdrops that catch the light.
prompt: A surreal Clockwork Orchid Garden: intricate brass gears and springs forming delicate orchid blossoms, each petal moving with subtle mechanical ticking, surrounding misty morning atmosphere, droplets of dew shimmering on metallic petals, soft golden sunrise filtering through, hyperrealistic detail, fantasy art style.
caption: Watch time bloom into beauty—the Clockwork Orchid Garden whispers the melody of moments in flower form 🌸⏰.
